example.intro: Mistport is a city ringed by tides and the whispers of old gods. While charting the coastal waters, a young surveyor, Lin Yan, finds an island that should not exist—one that appears only at a certain tide.
example.outline:
Act One: Lin Yan discovers the phantom island's coordinates and allies with Su Wan, nightkeeper of the archive.
Act Two: Following a tidal almanac, the two slip into an abandoned lighthouse and wake its sleeping guide.
Act Three: The truth surfaces—the island is a prison for an old god, and its key lies in Lin Yan's bloodline.
example.worldDesc: Aether rises and falls with the moon; casters are strongest at full moon and nearly powerless at new moon.
example.rule1: Aether flows from the tide; every spell must be primed with seawater.
example.rule2: A caster can hold only a limited number of true names; overreaching backlashes.
example.limitation: Casting on a new-moon night causes memory loss and is outlawed by the city.
example.casting: A ritual chant spoken through a shell engraved with a true name.
example.char1Personality: Calm and exacting, with an almost stubborn curiosity about the unknown.
example.char1Background: An orphan raised by the survey guild, fluent in old sea charts and tidal almanacs.
example.char1Motivation: To learn how his parents' disappearance connects to the phantom island.
example.char2Personality: Terse and watchful, hiding unease behind dry jokes.
example.char2Background: Nightkeeper of the archive, secretly a descendant of exiled old-god priests.
example.char2Motivation: To stop the old god from waking, even at the cost of herself.
example.chapter1Summary: While charting the coastal waters, Lin Yan finds coordinates for an island that appears only at a certain tide.
example.chapter2Summary: Su Wan confronts Lin Yan to warn him off the island, yet reveals she knows far too much.
